Building index · FY2027 roll

Manhattan buildings over the $1 million line

635 condos and 393 co-ops, from the FY2027 Department of Finance roll.

Buildings in Manhattan where the city's FY2027 values put apartments at or above the $1 million line for the pied-à-terre surcharge. Each page shows the counts, how the city valued the building and the TC107 deadline. None of this is a list of who pays: apartments that are someone's primary residence are exempt.
